title: Publish problems after the contest
description: Move the contest's problems (and editorials) to the public problem set. Each problem needs edit rights and the public-visibility permission; organization-private problems are skipped.
autoLabel: Publish automatically when the contest ends
autoHint: You are recorded as the one who turned it on. At the end your rights are checked again before anything is published.
notEnded: Problems can be published only after the contest ends. You can still turn on automatic publishing above.
dryRunFirst: Run a dry run with this exact choice first to see which problems would be published. Dry runs are unlimited; each person can publish for real at most 5 times an hour.
done: Published {published} problems, skipped {skipped}. Problem points and rankings will be recalculated.
confirmBody: {count} problems will go to the public problem set. There is no undo; every change is recorded in the problem history.

auto.scheduled: Automatic publishing is scheduled for the contest end.
auto.failed: Automatic publishing at {at} did not run: {reason}.

reasons.actor_unavailable: the user who turned it on can no longer act
reasons.no_permission: the user who turned it on no longer has the right to publish
reasons.cannot_edit_contest: the user who turned it on can no longer edit the contest
